import React from 'react'; import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'; import { Users, Heart, Calendar, TrendingUp, Activity, Leaf, Clock, Target } from 'lucide-react'; import { animalsAPI, scheduleAPI, healthAPI } from '../services/api'; import TestComponent from '../components/TestComponent'; const Dashboard = () => { const { data: animals = [] } = useQuery(['animals'], animalsAPI.getAll); const { data: upcomingTasks = [] } = useQuery(['upcomingTasks'], scheduleAPI.getUpcoming); const { data: healthStatus } = useQuery(['healthStatus'], healthAPI.getStatus); const stats = [ { label: 'Total Animals', value: animals.length, icon: Users, color: 'var(--primary-green)', change: '+12%' }, { label: 'Breeding Pairs', value: animals.filter(a => a.breedingStatus === 'BREEDING').length, icon: Heart, color: 'var(--farm-red)', change: '+5%' }, { label: 'Upcoming Tasks', value: upcomingTasks.length, icon: Calendar, color: 'var(--farm-orange)', change: '+3%' }, { label: 'Success Rate', value: '94%', icon: TrendingUp, color: 'var(--secondary-green)', change: '+2%' } ]; const recentAnimals = animals.slice(0, 5); const upcomingBreeding = upcomingTasks.slice(0, 3); return (

Farm Dashboard

Welcome back! Here's what's happening on your farm today.

System Online
{stats.map((stat, index) => (
{stat.change}
{stat.value}
{stat.label}
))}

Recent Animals

{recentAnimals.map((animal) => (
{animal.name}
{animal.type} {animal.gender} {animal.healthStatus}
{animal.breedingScore || 0}
))}
) : (

No Animals Yet

Add your first animal to get started with smart breeding.

)}

{upcomingBreeding.length > 0 ? (
{upcomingBreeding.map((task, index) => (
{task.title || 'Breeding Task'}
{new Date(task.scheduledDate).toLocaleDateString()}

))}
) : (

No Upcoming Tasks

Schedule breeding activities to see them here.

)}

Quick Actions

Database Connected
AI Service Active
Last Update {new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}
); }; export default Dashboard;
